uncertainty_notes: Excellent shared module pattern. DATA_TABLES vs PROTECTED_TABLES disjointness is the load-bearing invariant + explicitly tested. EXCEPT_MANUAL_TABLES is materialized (not computed) so diff-visible — explained in comment. Confirm tokens encode the scope they unlock (YES-DELETE-ALL-DATA / YES-DELETE-EXCEPT-MANUAL) so wrong-button mis-clicks fail closed. validateResetBody returns string on failure (descriptive) or typed ResetBody on success. No env vars or DB access — safe to import both client + server side per the comment.

test_coverage_gaps.description: No test for the actual delete behavior on the route (this module is just the validator).
test_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: The route's DELETE pipeline is what matters; this module enforces only the validation layer.

test_coverage_gaps.description: No test that the tokens cannot be brute-forced — but they're typed in by the operator, not network-submitted, so not a real threat under D-D2.
